title: Native reads wait out a backend drain
why: During an autodeploy reads answered 503 because the retry covered only about 3.75 s of refused connections.
changelog: a `GET` through `ctx.backend` asks again on a refused or reset connection or a 502, 503 or 504 with no code, `DRAINING` or `OVERLOADED`, honoring `Retry-After`, until one second before the load timeout; writes and backend error codes are never repeated
